Subject: Novatech: technical deep-dive & demo scheduling

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can get into the technical details with your ML/infra team:

What we heard from Novatech
- Primary use case: low-latency document summarization pipeline for customer support (750–2k tokens per request).
- Throughput target: ~120 requests/minute during peak (planning for bursts).
- Constraints: data residency (US), strict logging/audit requirements, and requirement to avoid persisting raw PII.

What Redwood can bring to the table
- Recommended approach: dedicated inference cluster (Reserved) + prefix caching for hot prompts, with optional private deployment if you need fully customer-managed VPC.
- Preliminary perf target: median p95 latency <120ms for 512-token responses on a 4xA100 cluster (subject to model selection/quant).

Requested next step
We’d like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with your ML and infra leads to:
1) walk through the current inference architecture and data flow,
2) validate latency/throughput targets and load profile,
3) review security/compliance touchpoints (KMS, audit logs),
4) discuss model variants (FP16 vs int8/4-bit quantization) and rollout plan, and
5) agree on a mutual action plan and timeline.

Proposed windows (all times PT) — please tell me what works for you or propose alternatives:
- Tue Mar 9: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Mar 10: 09:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:30
- Thu Mar 11: 11:00–12:30

Suggested attendees (we can adjust):
- Novatech: Olivia Zhang (PM), Samir Patel (Lead ML), Rajiv Menon (Infra)
- Redwood: Diego Fernández (AE), Priyom Das (Solutions Engineer), Evelyn Hart (Sales Lead)

I’ve attached a one-page draft MAP (mutual action plan) and included a scheduling link if you prefer an appointment pick: https://cal.com/diego-redwood/novatech-deep-dive

Attachment: Novatech-MAP-draft.pdf (stub)

If you can confirm a preferred slot and who will join from your side, I’ll send a calendar invite and share a short agenda doc ahead of the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the next conversation.

— Diego
